mapper.insert: WITH inserted_drink AS ( INSERT INTO drinks ( drink_id, drink_name, image_url, status, is_deleted, drink_category_id, shop_id ) VALUES ( gen_random_uuid(), #{drinkName}, #{imageUrl}, #{status}, #{isDeleted}, #{drinkCategoryId}, #{shopId} ) RETURNING drink_id ) INSERT INTO drink_details ( drink_detail_id, size, price, drink_id ) SELECT COALESCE(#{drinkDetailId}, gen_random_uuid()), #{size}, #{price}, drink_id FROM inserted_drink;
